June 26, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Rbo & Co Llc decreased its stake in Mondelez Inter (MDLZ) by 3.44% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rbo & Co Llc sold 9,920 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.59% with the market. The institutional investor held 278,389 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.62 million, down from 288,309 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rbo & Co Llc who had been investing in Mondelez Inter for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $60.83 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) has declined 14.94% since June 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.51% the S&P500.
